```
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
```

def load_grids():
    d = os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    sessions_file = d + '/../../sessions/' + os.path.basename(d) + '.jsonl'
    content = open(sessions_file).read()
    
    grids = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', content):
        k, h, w = m[1], int(m[2]), int(m[3])
        rows_content = content[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]
        rows = [r.split() for r in rows_content]
        if k not in grids and all(len(r) == w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            grids[k] = [[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return grids, content
